title: Figs. 18-19: GT-4 backup crew portraits, Frank Borman and James A. Lovell, Jr.
description: Two official portrait photographs of the GT-4 backup crew in suits and ties: Fig. 18 shows Frank Borman and Fig. 19 shows James A. Lovell, Jr., each with a name plate on the print. Surrounding text gives biographies of Edward H. White II (continued), Borman and Lovell.
